test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 03 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Six girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti and Kajal are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). Kajal is to immediate left of Mansi. Shweta is third to the left of Mansi. Payal is second to the right of Kajal. Monika is not second to the left of Mansi. Who is fourth to the right of Aarti?
solution: Given: Six girls Mansi, Shweta, Monika, Payal, Aarti and Kajal. 1) Kajal is to immediate left of Mansi. 2) Shweta is third to the left of Mansi. 3) Payal is second to the right of Kajal.
